transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because... well, I just can't seem to shake this feeling that I've failed. I feel like I failed as a father, and really just as a useful person in general. It just keeps looping in my head, over and over, until I honestly feel like I don't deserve much of a future.
How long have you been feeling this way?
It's been... about a month now. It started right around the time my daughter left for college out of state.
Over the past month, have you lost interest or pleasure in things you normally enjoy doing?

Yeah, I have. I used to really look forward to working on my model railway, or watching the Cubs games with my daughter. But now... well, the trains just sit there half-built on the table. And even just turning on a game on the TV feels completely pointless. I just don't have any interest in it anymore.
Have you ever experienced a period of feeling this down or losing interest like this before in your life?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had bad days or stressful weeks before, but... never anything like this. I've never just completely lost interest in my life before. This is the first time it's been this bad.
How has your sleep been over the past month?

It's been pretty bad. I usually just lie in bed for hours. The house is just... it's too quiet now. And even when I do finally fall asleep, I end up waking up around three or four in the morning. After that, I just can't get back to sleep at all. My mind just starts running through everything I've messed up, and I just lie there awake.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or lacking energy lately?

Yeah, definitely. I just have absolutely no energy. Even simple things... like trying to carry the laundry upstairs, or just sitting there sorting the mail... it feels like I'm moving through wet cement. And it doesn't matter how long I've been lying in bed, I just always feel completely drained.
When you mention feeling like you don't deserve much of a future, have you had any thoughts of wanting to end your life or hurt yourself?

Well... yes. I've been having thoughts that it would just be easier if I didn't wake up. It actually scared me a bit recently, because I caught myself going over all my finances... organizing everything, almost like I was getting things ready for someone else to take over. So, yes, those thoughts have been there.
